text:
گھوٹیے گھٹک گھٹک،
چھانیے چھنک چھنک،
پیویے گھٹک گھٹک،
چلیے لٹک لٹک۔
romanized:
Ghoṭīe ghuṭakk ghuṭakk,
Chhānīe chhanakk chhanakk,
Pīvīe ghuṭakk ghuṭakk,
Challīe laṭakk laṭakk.
literal_en:
Grind your bhang with a rub rub,
Strain it with a whish whish,
Drink it with a gulp gulp,
Walk with a swing swing.

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
